{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders with positive revenue
completed_positive_revenue = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = completed_positive_revenue['revenue'].sum()

# Print the total revenue
total_revenue"}
